description: INFLUENCE — project a set of fixes onto a provider's agent-readiness score and band before doing the work. Re-applies the band gate to the PROJECTED state, so it will tell you when buying points still leaves you demoted. Kin Score facets are refused rather than estimated: several checks behind them are count-based across a provider's APIs, so a single claimed fix has no computable composite value. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

fixes.description: Agent-readiness dimension ids to assume fixed, e.g. ["idempotency","mcp_server"]. what_can_i_fix lists the available ones.
